name: Darkened Shadow Cannon

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-08: Battle for Star's Fate

stealth.details: (untrained) or DC 13 Perception check to notice the cannon

disable: DC 23 Arcana check or DC 23 Thievery check on the cannon's body to deactivate
routine: (1 action) The cannon fires a blast that contains as many PCs as possible, choosing randomly in the event of a tie.

items.name: Load the Cannons
items.text:
Trigger The ship flies within 30 feet of Star

Effect The cannon rolls initiative.

text: A cannon built of cast iron and infused with shadow magic, mounted on the side of Aslynn's flying ship.
